title: The Stable
offer: Ragnfrid's foal needs a stable before she comes. Bring six logs from Arne's forest in Frosttorp, a crate of iron tools from the smith, and tar from Ekvik. Six logs are more than your boat holds!

steps.load_say: Good straight pine. Load what fits, and come back for the rest.

steps.say: Nails and an axe: now we can build.
Hammer, saw, tar on the roof... The stable stands! And we bought the east meadow for the foal to run in.

fact: Viking houses were built of wood, with roofs of turf, thatch or shingles.
